content: CarPlay entitlement: apply at developer.apple.com/contact/carplay/ (requires Apple Developer login). Apple's 2026 CarPlay page lists supported app categories including VIDEO apps: 'Video apps can play video content in supported cars when parked' and new CarPlay video templates in the CarPlay framework. Audio/media entitlement remains the conventional path for CarTube's webview-video approach; the video category is notable as an alternate official route but requires template rebuild (explicitly out of scope).
